content:
Rina: Quick UX pass on the playground convo — two things: token counter placement inside streaming bubble vs fixed footer, and how prompt library suggestions should appear while streaming. Mock: https://redwood.design/mockups/convoui/v11.png Tom: Counter inside bubble looks cleaner visually, but it adds noise when tokens update every few chunks. maybe show a compact static count that updates only every N seconds or on chunk boundaries. Leah: From a discoverability POV users want to see token spend near the output when it's long. I vote for a small muted `123 tokens` in the bottom-left of the bubble. clicking it opens a breakdown panel. Chris: Implementation detail: if we debounce the counter updates to 500ms and animate opacity, we can avoid layout jank. also recommend using data-attribute toggles instead of rerendering full message. Ben: Prompt library integration: when suggestions pop in while streaming, they shouldn't steal focus. we can show a subtle rail button `+Prompts` that expands on hover/click. inside expansion show pinned prompts and a quick-insert icon. Leah: UX caveat: quick-insert while streaming should append to composer but not interrupt stream. we should surface a small callout: `Added prompt to composer` with undo. Rina: accessibility notes: a11y-bot recommended that the token counter be `role=status` and programmatically announced on stream end. avoid continuous spoken updates. also ensure live updates to the bubble are not triggering full re-reads for NVDA/VoiceOver. a11y-bot: Automated suggestion: set aria-live="polite" on the status region and use aria-atomic="false". provide aria-label on counter: `Token count: 123, updated` only on change. Ensure color contrast >= 4.5:1 for readable numbers. Tom: for keyboard users, tab order should go: message -> controls overlay (stop/regenerate) -> counter -> prompt expand. shortcut: `Esc` to stop, `Shift+P` to open prompts. Chris: control overlay idea: single compact overlay attached to the streaming message with two icons: stop (primary) and menu (secondary). clicking menu reveals `Regenerate`, `Copy`, `Add to prompt lib`. overlay only appears for the active stream message. Ben: Microcopy option: label stop as `Stop` and tooltip `Stop generation — shortcut Esc`. Regenerate verb is fine. For prompt library action, `Save as prompt` vs `Add to library`? I prefer `Save prompt` (short). Leah: small prototype: ```html
Partial output...
345 tokens
``` Rina: good. also ensure token counter has `aria-hidden=true` for decorative numeric glyphs, and expose a screenreader-only summary: `Token count: 345 tokens` when stream ends. a11y-bot: Also flag: interactive overlays must have 44px touch target, and focus styles should be visible when using high-contrast mode. Tom: metrics: track `playground.token_ui_view`, `playground.prompt_quickinsert`, `playground.interrupt_click`. include context tags: user_tier, model_size, session_len. Chris: dev plan: I'll implement overlay + debounced counter in a feature-flag branch. will include an experiment param that toggles counter location (bubble vs footer). ETA: next Wed. Leah: let's run 6 moderated sessions focusing on: can users find Stop quickly, do they notice token counter, does prompt quick-insert feel interruptive. I'll draft tasks. Ben: microcopy tweak: use em dash in tooltip: `Stop generation — shortcut Esc` (no parentheses). Rina: final decision for this iteration: overlay with Stop + menu on streaming message, compact token counter in bubble (announce on start+end only), prompt library entry via menu (quick-insert to composer). Leah to run usability sessions, Chris to PR, Tom to add keyboard shortcuts, a11y-bot to re-run checks after PR. Chris: PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/playground/pull/501 (WIP). includes demo video and perf notes. Leah: usability test invites sent for Tue/Thu next week. Rina: thanks all — closing after PR merge and a11y signoff.
